Barbie and the Diamond Castle

Spoiler warning: this page tells the whole plot.

Short Summary

Liana and Alexa are best friends with big dreams and a shared love of music. When they find a muse named Melody trapped in a magic mirror, it leads them to the Diamond Castle and a face-off with Lydia, a witch who betrayed the muses.

Full Story

The story is told by Barbie and Teresa to Stacie, who has just had a fight with her friend Courtney. To show her what real friendship means, they tell her the tale of two best friends, Liana and Alexa.

Liana and Alexa are young women who live in a village and dream of becoming musicians. Liana is the hopeful dreamer, while Alexa is more practical, but they always stick together. One day, they discover a magic mirror with a muse named Melody trapped inside. Melody explains that she was once the apprentice of three Muses of Music, Dori, Phaedra, and Lydia, who lived in the Diamond Castle and watched over the magic of music. Lydia turned evil, wanted the castle all to herself, and turned Dori and Phaedra to stone. Before that happened, the Muses hid the castle and left Melody the key to protect it.

Liana insists on helping Melody, and Alexa reluctantly agrees. Lydia sends her dragon minion, Slyder, after them, and the girls lose their home. They set off together to find the Diamond Castle before Lydia does. Along the way, they find two lost puppies, which they adopt and name Sparkles and Lily. In a village inn, they also meet twin musicians, Ian and Jeremy, who become their friends and join the journey.

Lydia keeps trying to stop them. She uses a spell to take control of Alexa, which tests the girls' friendship, and Slyder captures Liana. Even so, the two friends find their way back to each other, and their bond becomes their greatest strength. With Melody and the others beside them, they reach the Diamond Castle and use the Muses' musical instruments to defeat Lydia.

Dori and Phaedra are freed from stone, and Melody is welcomed as a true muse. As a thank you, the Muses give the girls magic seeds that bring their garden back to life, and Ian and Jeremy go on to become musicians. The story ends with a message that true friendship is the real treasure. Back in the present, Stacie apologizes to Courtney, and Barbie and Teresa happily go back to playing their music.

Conclusion

Liana and Alexa save the Diamond Castle, free the Muses, and prove that friendship is the true treasure. The adventure shows that when friends trust each other and stay together, they can overcome any challenge. Hearing it, Stacie realizes that nothing can break a true friendship and goes to make up with Courtney.

Fun facts

  • It was directed by Gino Nichele and produced by Rainmaker Entertainment and Mattel Entertainment.
  • This is the first Barbie film to feature Stacie in place of Kelly.
  • The song "Connected" is an English cover of "Tenerte y Quererte" by the Mexican pop group RBD.
  • Liana and Alexa wear the same two dresses for most of the movie, which is unusual for a Barbie film.
  • Ian and Jeremy joke in a song that nothing rhymes with orange.

← All characters

Liana

Main Character

About

Liana is one of the two main heroes of the story (played by Barbie). She is kind, hopeful, and always ready to help others. Her big dream is to make music, and she believes in following it. She is the one who insists on helping Melody and never gives up on her best friend Alexa.

Liana is the role Barbie plays in the story she tells her sister. She lives in a cottage with her best friend Alexa, loves music, and dreams of a bigger life.

In the movie

After Liana and Alexa find Melody trapped in a magic mirror, they set out to restore the Diamond Castle before Lydia can take it. Liana’s necklace helps protect her from Lydia’s flute spell. At the end, the muses name her a princess of music.

Relationships

  • Alexa: Her best friend and partner on the quest
  • Melody: The muse she helps free from the mirror
  • Jeremy: One of the twin musicians; he falls in love with her
  • Lydia: The witch who tries to stop her

Fun facts

  • In the real world, Liana is played by Barbie, and Alexa by Teresa.
  • The story is told by Barbie to her little sister Stacie.

Alexa

Main Character

About

Alexa (played by Teresa) is Liana's best friend and the other main hero. She is more practical and cautious than Liana, and she is a bit reluctant at first to take on the adventure. Still, she is loyal and brave, and she sticks with Liana to the end. She also loves music and shares Liana's dream.

In the movie

Alexa reluctantly agrees to help Melody and joins Liana on the journey to the Diamond Castle. Lydia puts her under a spell and uses her to threaten Melody, which tests the girls' friendship. Once she is free, she helps defeat Lydia. At the end, the Muses name her a princess of music.

Relationships

  • Liana: Her best friend and partner on the quest
  • Melody: The muse she helps protect
  • Ian: One of the twin musicians; her love interest
  • Lily: The puppy she names after a flower
  • Lydia: The witch who puts her under a spell

Fun facts

  • In the story Barbie tells, Alexa is the role played by Teresa.
  • She is voiced by Cassidy Ladden.

Melody

Main Character (Muse)

About

Melody is a young muse and the apprentice of the three Muses of Music. She is gentle, brave, and devoted to the Diamond Castle. She holds the key that protects it.

In the movie

Melody is trapped in a magic mirror until Liana and Alexa free her. She tells them about Lydia's betrayal and guides them to the Diamond Castle. At the end, Dori and Phaedra welcome her as a real muse.

Relationships

  • Liana and Alexa: The friends who free her and travel with her
  • Dori and Phaedra: The Muses who taught her
  • Lydia: Her former teacher who turned against the Muses

Fun facts

  • Maryke Hendrikse voices Melody, and Lara Janine does her singing.

Lydia

Main Villain

About

Lydia is the main villain. She was once a Muse of Music like Dori and Phaedra, but she betrayed them because she wanted to rule the Diamond Castle for herself. She is jealous and power-hungry, and she uses spells to get what she wants.

In the movie

Lydia turns Dori and Phaedra to stone and sends Slyder after Melody and the girls. She uses a spell to control Alexa. In the end, Liana and Alexa use the Muses' instruments to defeat her.

Relationships

  • Slyder: Her dragon minion
  • Dori and Phaedra: Her former fellow Muses, whom she betrayed
  • Melody: The apprentice she wants to capture
  • Liana and Alexa: The heroes who stop her

Fun facts

  • Kathleen Barr voices Lydia.

Dori
